papers.title: Transseptal Transcatheter Mitral Valve Replacement for Mitral Annular Calcification: ENCIRCLE MAC Registry 1-Year Outcomes.
papers.summary: Prospective multicentre single-arm ENCIRCLE MAC Registry of transseptal TMVR with the SAPIEN M3 system in patients with symptomatic MAC-related mitral valve dysfunction unsuitable for surgery or transcatheter repair. Of 364 screened, TMVR was attempted in 100 and the valve implanted in 93 (mean age 76.1 years; 73% NYHA III/IV; mean STS PROM 8.4%). At 1 year, the Kaplan-Meier estimate of all-cause mortality or heart failure hospitalisation was 33.6% (95% CI 25.0-44.1%), with 21.1% all-cause mortality and 19.4% HF hospitalisation; disabling stroke 5.1%, clinically significant LVOT obstruction 4.8%, valve thrombosis 2.3%, haemolysis needing transfusion or reintervention 9.2%, and mitral reintervention 11.4%. Among implanted patients, MR ≤1+ was achieved in 98.5% at 1 year, with sustained gains in NYHA class, KCCQ and 6-minute walk.

papers.title: A Proactive Digital Valve Care Pathway for Management of Severe Aortic Stenosis: The DETECT AS II Study.
papers.summary: No abstract was available for this paper, so no results are reported here. Based on its title and publisher note, this nonrandomised clinical trial examines a proactive digital valve care pathway aimed at timely management of severe aortic stenosis. See the full paper for the study design, patient numbers and findings.
